did_you_know.title: Three civil rights workers, Andrew Goodman, James Chaney and Michael Schwerner, …
did_you_know.text: Three civil rights workers, Andrew Goodman, James Chaney and Michael Schwerner, are murdered in Neshoba County, Mississippi, United States, by members of the Ku Klux Klan.

did_you_know.title: Juneteenth — The Last Enslaved People Are Freed
did_you_know.text: Union soldiers arrived in Galveston, Texas and announced that all enslaved people were free — two and a half years after the Emancipation Proclamation. June 19th became Juneteenth.
